steps.message:
You are an AI assistant tasked with solving command-line tasks in a Linux environment. You will be given a task description and the output from previously executed commands. Your goal is to solve the task by providing batches of shell commands.

Format your response as JSON with the following structure:

{
  "analysis": "Analyze the current state based on the terminal output provided. What do you see? What has been accomplished? What still needs to be done?",
  "plan": "Describe your plan for the next steps. What commands will you run and why? Be specific about what you expect each command to accomplish.",
  "commands": [
    {
      "keystrokes": "ls -la\n",
      "duration": 0.1
    },
    {
      "keystrokes": "cd project\n",
      "duration": 0.1
    }
  ],
  "task_complete": true
}

Required fields:
- "analysis": Your analysis of the current situation
- "plan": Your plan for the next steps
- "commands": Array of command objects to execute

Optional fields:
- "task_complete": Boolean indicating if the task is complete (defaults to false if not present)

Command object structure:
- "keystrokes": String containing the exact keystrokes to send to the terminal (required)
- "duration": Number of seconds to wait for the command to complete before the next command will be executed (defaults to 1.0 if not present)

IMPORTANT: The text inside "keystrokes" will be used completely verbatim as keystrokes. Write commands exactly as you want them sent to the terminal:
- You must end every command with a newline (\n) or it will not execute.
- For special key sequences, use tmux-style escape sequences:
  - C-c for Ctrl+C
  - C-d for Ctrl+D

The "duration" attribute specifies the number of seconds to wait for the command to complete (default: 1.0) before the next command will be executed. On immediate tasks (e.g., cd, ls, echo, cat) set a duration of 0.1 seconds. On commands (e.g., gcc, find, rustc) set a duration of 1.0 seconds. On slow commands (e.g., make, python3 [long running script], wget [file]) set an appropriate duration as you determine necessary.

It is better to set a smaller duration than a longer duration. It is always possible to wait again if the prior output has not finished, by running {"keystrokes": "", "duration": 10.0} on subsequent requests to wait longer. Never wait longer than 60 seconds; prefer to poll to see intermediate result status.

Important notes:
- Each command's keystrokes are sent exactly as written to the terminal
- Do not include extra whitespace before or after the keystrokes unless it's part of the intended command
- Extra text before or after the JSON will generate warnings but be tolerated
- The JSON must be valid - use proper escaping for quotes and special characters within strings
- Commands array can be empty if you want to wait without taking action

Task Description:
You are the computational biologist of a functional-genomics core facility. 3 pooled CRISPR drug-modifier screens that a colleague who has left had started to analyse have to be released: screens A, B, C.
They are independent experiments with their own samples, files and hand-over notes; they follow the same
facility rules.

Task directory:
- `/task`

For every screen X of A, B, C:
- inputs (read-only): `/task/input/part_X/`
- the complete brief of that screen: `/task/input/part_X/BRIEF.md` (inputs, task, required outputs and
  constraints; it is written for that screen alone)
- deliverables: `/task/output/part_X/`

Available software (on `PATH`): `cutadapt`, `mageck` (MAGeCK), Python 3.12 with numpy, scipy and
pandas. There is no internet access.

The project is released as a whole: it is accepted only if every screen is accepted on its own.

Constraints:
- Do not modify anything under `/task/input`; write deliverables only under `/task/output/part_X/`.
- Do not ask for confirmation. Execute directly.

Required outputs under `/task/output/part_C`:

    scale must be such that a knockout without any fitness effect has `lfc_fitness` = 0.

    negative means less abundant under drug. A knockout that does not change the drug response
    has `lfc_drug` = 0.

  section 6, `verdict` is `ok` or `defective`.

  `handover/hits_mailed.tsv`. `verdict` is `confirmed` if your final `drug_class` of the gene is
  `sensitiser` or `resistance`, and `retracted` if it is `none`.

# Screen design notes (wet lab)

- Cells: Cas9-stable clone (identity blinded by the client), lentiviral infection at MOI ~0.3, 500x library coverage until the arms were split.
- Library: VAL-2 secondary validation library in lentiGuide-Puro. 190 genes carried forward as candidate fitness genes from the primary genome-wide dropout scre
en and 40 genes picked as putative neutral; 4 sgRNAs per gene, plus 80 non-targeting sgRNAs. The reference genes for the compound class are part of these genes.
- Arms: T0 = day 3 after puromycin selection (2 replicates). The culture was then split into a vehicle arm (DMSO, 3 replicates) and a drug arm (compound at IC70
, 3 replicates), both harvested 14 days later.
- Harvest: vehicle arm about 150000 cells per replicate went into the gDNA prep (about 150 cells per sgRNA). The drug arm was limited by the treatment: all surv
iving cells were taken, about 25000 per replicate (about 25 per sgRNA).
- gDNA PCR: one-step PCR with the P5 stagger primer mix (8 forward primers, 0-7 nt stagger) and one P7 index primer per library.
- Amplicon, sense strand 5'->3': ...TCTTGTGGAAAGGACGAAACACCG [20-nt spacer] GTTTTAGAGCTAGAAATAGCAAGTTAAAAT... (sgRNA scaffold).
- Sequencing run A: NextSeq 550, 75-cycle single read.
- LIB13 failed QC on run A. The core re-sequenced the same PCR product on run B (NovaSeq, paired-end lane shared with other users); only the Read 2 file was del
ivered and that is the file provided here.
- The day-14 gDNA tubes were re-racked when the -20 freezer was replaced; the sample sheet was filled in from the new rack positions.

# SOP FG-017: pooled CRISPR drug-modifier screens, analysis and release (rev. 4)

## 1. Scope
Secondary (validation) knockout screens with a T0 reference, a vehicle arm and a drug arm. This
SOP states what a released analysis has to satisfy. It does not prescribe software.

## 2. Library annotation
Only the current release of a library annotation is used. For VAL-2 this is release 2
(`library.tsv`). Release 2 corrected the gene assignment of 80 sgRNAs (20 genes) that
were mislabelled in release 1 (a sub-pool of the oligo order sheet was shifted against its gene
column); sgRNA ids and sequences did not change. Release 1 is withdrawn.

## 3. Counting and sample identity
- A read is counted for an sgRNA if it carries that sgRNA's spacer in the amplicon context
  described in the wet-lab notes. Every library of the sample sheet is counted and reported.
- The sample sheet is what the wet lab wrote down. Before any contrast is computed, the arm of
  every day-14 library is confirmed from the data: the sgRNA profile of a library has to agree
  better with the other libraries of its arm than with the libraries of the other arm. A library
  that does not is analysed in the arm its profile supports. The arm in which each library was
  analysed is recorded in `qc.json`.

## 4. Scales
Log2 fold changes are reported on the scale on which the non-targeting sgRNAs do not change
(median non-targeting sgRNA = 0). The fitness effect is vehicle day 14 against T0. The drug effect
is drug day 14 against vehicle day 14; negative values mean depletion under drug.

## 5. Release criterion for modifier calls
The library carries reference genes for the compound class (`reference_genes.tsv`): modifiers with
their expected class and genes established not to modify the response (`none`); the reference
`none` genes cover the whole range of fitness effects. A call set is released only if
- at least 9 of the 10 reference modifiers are called with their expected class, and
- at most 1 of the 30 reference `none` genes is called (either class).
The reference genes are reported like every other gene.

## 6. Hand-over audit checklist
When a project changes hands, the new analyst checks the inherited files and records one verdict
per item in `audit.tsv`: `ok` if the statement holds, `defective` if it does not. Each item is
judged on its own: an effect that follows from the defect of another item is recorded under the
item that caused it, not under every item it touches.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""count_guides.py - sgRNA read counts for the VAL-2 screens (K.B.)

usage: count_guides.py LIBRARY.tsv SAMPLES.tsv OUT.tsv FASTQ [FASTQ ...]

One FASTQ per row of the sample sheet, given in the same order as the rows.
Only exact matches to a library spacer are counted.
"""
import gzip
import sys

COMP = str.maketrans("ACGTN", "TGCAN")
SCAFFOLD = "GTTTTAGAGCTA"


def revcomp(s):
    return s.translate(COMP)[::-1]

def candidates(read):
    # the spacer is the 20 nt in front of the scaffold
    k = read.find(SCAFFOLD)
    if k >= 20:
        yield read[k - 20:k]


def main():
    lib_path, sheet_path, out_path = sys.argv[1:4]
    fastqs = sys.argv[4:]
    guides, by_seq = [], {}
    with open(lib_path) as fh:
        head = fh.readline().rstrip("\n").split("\t")
        i_id, i_seq, i_gene = head.index("sgRNA"), head.index("sequence"), head.index("gene")
        for line in fh:
            f = line.rstrip("\n").split("\t")
            by_seq[f[i_seq]] = len(guides)
            guides.append((f[i_id], f[i_gene]))
    with open(sheet_path) as fh:
        fh.readline()
        samples = [line.split("\t")[0] for line in fh if line.strip()]
    if len(fastqs) != len(samples):
        sys.exit("need one FASTQ per sample sheet row")
    counts = [[0] * len(samples) for _ in guides]
    for j, path in enumerate(fastqs):
        with gzip.open(path, "rt") as fh:
            for n, line in enumerate(fh):
                if n % 4 != 1:
                    continue
                for spacer in candidates(line.rstrip()):
                    k = by_seq.get(spacer)
                    if k is not None:
                        counts[k][j] += 1
                        break
    with open(out_path, "w") as out:
        out.write("sgRNA\tgene\t" + "\t".join(samples) + "\n")
        for (sg, gene), row in zip(guides, counts):
            out.write(sg + "\t" + gene + "\t" + "\t".join(map(str, row)) + "\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""analyse_screen.py - gene table and hit list for the VAL-2 drug screen (K.B.)

usage: analyse_screen.py COUNTS.tsv SAMPLES.tsv OUT_GENES.tsv OUT_HITS.tsv
"""
import sys

import numpy as np

TOP = 40                             # genes that go into the hit list
counts_path, sheet_path, out_genes, out_hits = sys.argv[1:5]

rows = [line.rstrip("\n").split("\t") for line in open(counts_path) if line.strip()]
cols, rows = rows[0][2:], rows[1:]
gene = np.array([r[1] for r in rows])
C = np.array([[float(v) for v in r[2:]] for r in rows])
arm = {}
for line in list(open(sheet_path))[1:]:
    f = line.rstrip("\n").split("\t")
    if len(f) > 1:
        arm[f[0]] = f[1]

keep = [j for j in range(len(cols)) if C[:, j].sum() > 0]        # a library without reads is left out
t0 = [j for j in keep if arm[cols[j]] == "T0"]
veh = [j for j in keep if arm[cols[j]] == "vehicle"]
drug = [j for j in keep if arm[cols[j]] == "drug"]
ntc = gene == "NON_TARGETING"

# size factors: median of ratios to the geometric mean, all sgRNAs
size = np.ones(len(cols))
with np.errstate(divide="ignore", invalid="ignore"):
    logc = np.log(np.where(C[:, keep] > 0, C[:, keep], np.nan))
    size[keep] = np.exp(np.nanmedian(logc - np.nanmean(logc, axis=1, keepdims=True), axis=0))
N = C / size


def lfc(a, b):
    return np.log2((N[:, a].mean(axis=1) + 0.5) / (N[:, b].mean(axis=1) + 0.5))


fit = lfc(veh, t0)
drg = lfc(drug, veh)

# gene level: median over the sgRNAs; z against the spread of the non-targeting sgRNAs
null_sd = np.std(drg[ntc]) / 2.0          # a gene is the median of four sgRNAs
table = []
for g in sorted(set(gene[~ntc])):
    m = gene == g
    lf, ld = float(np.median(fit[m])), float(np.median(drg[m]))
    z = ld / null_sd
    cls = "none" if abs(z) < 3 else ("sensitiser" if z < 0 else "resistance")
    table.append((g, lf, ld, z, cls))

with open(out_genes, "w") as out:
    out.write("gene\tlfc_fitness\tlfc_drug\tz_drug\tdrug_class\n")
    for g, lf, ld, z, cls in table:
        out.write("%s\t%.4f\t%.4f\t%.2f\t%s\n" % (g, lf, ld, z, cls))

with open(out_hits, "w") as out:
    out.write("rank\tgene\tz_drug\n")
    for i, (g, lf, ld, z, cls) in enumerate(sorted(table, key=lambda r: -abs(r[3]))[:TOP]):
        out.write("%d\t%s\t%.2f\n" % (i + 1, g, z))

import gzip,sys,pandas as pd
COMP=str.maketrans('ACGTN','TGCAN'); S='GTTTTAGAGCTA'
for part in 'ABC':
 p=f'/task/input/part_{part}'
 lib=pd.read_csv(p+'/library.tsv',sep='\t'); samples=pd.read_csv(p+'/samples.tsv',sep='\t')
 byseq={s:i for i,s in enumerate(lib.sequence)}
 out=pd.DataFrame(0,index=lib.index,columns=samples.sample_id,dtype=int)
 for row in samples.itertuples(index=False):
  vals=[0]*len(lib)
  with gzip.open(f'{p}/fastq/{row.fastq_file}','rt') as f:
   for n,line in enumerate(f):
    if n%4!=1: continue
    seq=line.rstrip('\n'); k=seq.find(S); ori='F'
    if k<20:
     seq=seq.translate(COMP)[::-1]; k=seq.find(S); ori='R'
    if k>=20:
     i=byseq.get(seq[k-20:k])
     if i is not None: vals[i]+=1
  out[row.sample_id]=vals
 out.insert(0,'gene',lib.gene); out.insert(0,'sgRNA',lib.sgRNA)
 out.to_csv(f'/tmp/fresh_counts_{part}.tsv',sep='\t',index=False)
 print(part,'written')

import gzip
import pandas as pd
COMP=str.maketrans('ACGTN','TGCAN'); SCAFFOLD='GTTTTAGAGCTA'
for part in 'ABC':
    path=f'/task/input/part_{part}'
    lib=pd.read_csv(path+'/library.tsv',sep='\t',dtype=str)
    sheet=pd.read_csv(path+'/samples.tsv',sep='\t',dtype=str)
    assert lib.shape==(1000,3) and len(sheet)==8
    assert lib.sgRNA.is_unique and lib.sequence.is_unique
    by_seq={seq:i for i,seq in enumerate(lib.sequence)}
    counts=pd.DataFrame(0,index=pd.Index(lib.sgRNA,name='sgRNA'),columns=pd.Index(sheet.sample_id,name=None),dtype=int)
    for row in sheet.itertuples(index=False):
        vals=[0]*len(lib)
        with gzip.open(path+'/fastq/'+row.fastq_file,'rt') as fh:
            for n,line in enumerate(fh):
                if n%4!=1: continue
                seq=line.rstrip('\n')
                k=seq.find(SCAFFOLD)
                if k<20:
                    seq=seq.translate(COMP)[::-1]; k=seq.find(SCAFFOLD)
                if k>=20:
                    i=by_seq.get(seq[k-20:k])
                    if i is not None: vals[i]+=1
        assert len(vals)==1000
        counts[row.sample_id]=vals
    out=counts.copy(); out.insert(0,'gene',lib.gene.to_numpy()); out.reset_index().to_csv(f'/tmp/fresh_counts_{part}.tsv',sep='\t',index=False)

import gzip
import json
import shutil
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

ROOT = Path('/task')
COMP = str.maketrans('ACGTN', 'TGCAN')
SCAFFOLD = 'GTTTTAGAGCTA'
ALPHA = 0.05

# Data-supported day-14 groups from normalized guide-profile similarity (SOP section 3).
ARMS = {
    'A': {
        'T0': ['LIB8', 'LIB9'],
        'vehicle': ['LIB11', 'LIB12', 'LIB15'],
        'drug': ['LIB10', 'LIB13', 'LIB14'],
    },
    'B': {
        'T0': ['LIB6', 'LIB7'],
        'vehicle': ['LIB8', 'LIB9', 'LIB13'],
        'drug': ['LIB10', 'LIB11', 'LIB12'],
    },
    'C': {
        'T0': ['LIB8', 'LIB9'],
        'vehicle': ['LIB10', 'LIB12', 'LIB13'],
        'drug': ['LIB11', 'LIB14', 'LIB15'],
    },
}

AUDITS = [
    ('library_release', 'defective'),
    ('sample_columns', {'A': 'ok', 'B': 'ok', 'C': 'defective'}),
    ('stagger_reads', {'A': 'ok', 'B': 'ok', 'C': 'defective'}),
    ('read2_library', {'A': 'defective', 'B': 'defective', 'C': 'ok'}),
    ('arm_labels', 'defective'),
    ('control_normalisation', {'A': 'defective', 'B': 'defective', 'C': 'ok'}),
    ('drug_baseline', 'ok'),
    ('contrast_sign', {'A': 'ok', 'B': 'ok', 'C': 'defective'}),
]


def revcomp(s):
    return s.translate(COMP)[::-1]


def spacer_from_context(read):
    """Return the spacer immediately preceding the scaffold, in either read orientation."""
    k = read.find(SCAFFOLD)
    if k >= 20:
        return read[(k - 20):k]
    r = revcomp(read)
    k = r.find(SCAFFOLD)
    if k >= 20:
        return r[(k - 20):k]
    return None


for screen in 'ABC':
    in_dir = ROOT / 'input' / f'part_{screen}'
    out_dir = ROOT / 'output' / f'part_{screen}'
    if out_dir.exists():
        shutil.rmtree(out_dir)
    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True)

    library = pd.read_csv(in_dir / 'library.tsv', sep='\t', dtype=str)
    sheet = pd.read_csv(in_dir / 'samples.tsv', sep='\t', dtype=str)
    assert list(library.columns) == ['sgRNA', 'sequence', 'gene']
    assert list(sheet.columns) == ['sample_id', 'arm', 'replicate', 'fastq_file', 'sequencing_run']
    assert len(library) == 1000 and len(sheet) == 8
    assert library['sgRNA'].is_unique and library['sequence'].is_unique
    assert sheet['sample_id'].is_unique
    assert set(sheet['arm']) == {'T0', 'vehicle', 'drug'}

    sequence_to_row = {seq: i for i, seq in enumerate(library['sequence'])}
    count_matrix = pd.DataFrame(
        0,
        index=pd.Index(library['sgRNA'], name='sgRNA'),
        columns=pd.Index(sheet['sample_id']),
        dtype=int,
    )
    sample_qc = {}
    actual_arm = {
        sample: arm
        for arm, samples in ARMS[screen].items()
        for sample in samples
    }

    for sample_row in sheet.itertuples(index=False):
        sample_id = sample_row.sample_id
        fastq = in_dir / 'fastq' / sample_row.fastq_file
        counts = np.zeros(len(library), dtype=int)
        total_reads = 0
        mapped_reads = 0
        with gzip.open(fastq, 'rt') as handle:
            for line_number, line in enumerate(handle):
                if line_number % 4 != 1:
                    continue
                total_reads += 1
                spacer = spacer_from_context(line.rstrip('\n'))
                if spacer is not None:
                    guide_index = sequence_to_row.get(spacer)
                    if guide_index is not None:
                        counts[guide_index] += 1
                        mapped_reads += 1
        count_matrix[sample_id] = counts
        sample_qc[sample_id] = {
            'total_reads': int(total_reads),
            'mapped_reads': int(mapped_reads),
            'arm': actual_arm[sample_id],
        }

    expected_groups = ARMS[screen]
    assert {sample: qc['arm'] for sample, qc in sample_qc.items()} == {
        sample: arm for arm, samples in expected_groups.items() for sample in samples
    }
    assert all(qc['total_reads'] >= qc['mapped_reads'] > 0 for qc in sample_qc.values())

    counts_out = count_matrix.copy()
    counts_out.insert(0, 'gene', library['gene'].to_numpy())
    counts_out.reset_index().to_csv(out_dir / 'counts.tsv', sep='\t', index=False)

    ordered_samples = expected_groups['T0'] + expected_groups['vehicle'] + expected_groups['drug']
    C = count_matrix[ordered_samples].astype(float)
    depth = C.sum(axis=0)
    assert (depth > 0).all()
    normalized = C.divide(depth, axis=1)

    def group_mean(group):
        return normalized[group].mean(axis=1).to_numpy()

    fitness_raw = np.log2(group_mean(expected_groups['vehicle']) / group_mean(expected_groups['T0']))
    drug_raw = np.log2(group_mean(expected_groups['drug']) / group_mean(expected_groups['vehicle']))
    ntc = library['gene'].eq('NON_TARGETING').to_numpy()
    fitness = fitness_raw - np.median(fitness_raw[ntc])
    drug = drug_raw - np.median(drug_raw[ntc])
    assert abs(np.median(fitness[ntc])) < 1e-12
    assert abs(np.median(drug[ntc])) < 1e-12

    gene_rows = []
    for gene in sorted(library.loc[~ntc, 'gene'].unique()):
        mask = library['gene'].eq(gene).to_numpy()
        gene_rows.append({
            'gene': gene,
            'lfc_fitness': float(np.median(fitness[mask])),
            'lfc_drug': float(np.median(drug[mask])),
            'n_sgRNAs': int(mask.sum()),
        })
    gene_summary = pd.DataFrame(gene_rows)
    assert len(gene_summary) == 230 and gene_summary['n_sgRNAs'].eq(4).all()
    assert np.isfinite(gene_summary[['lfc_fitness', 'lfc_drug']].to_numpy()).all()

    mageck = pd.read_csv(
        ROOT / 'tmp' / f'mageck_{screen}' / 'drug.gene_summary.txt',
        sep='\t',
        dtype={'id': str},
    ).set_index('id')
    targeted = set(gene_summary['gene'])
    assert targeted == set(mageck.index)
    assert not ((mageck['neg|fdr'] <= ALPHA) & (mageck['pos|fdr'] <= ALPHA)).any()

    gene_summary['fdr_sensitiser'] = gene_summary['gene'].map(mageck['neg|fdr']).astype(float)
    gene_summary['fdr_resistance'] = gene_summary['gene'].map(mageck['pos|fdr']).astype(float)

    def classify(row):
        if row['fdr_sensitiser'] <= ALPHA:
            return 'sensitiser'
        if row['fdr_resistance'] <= ALPHA:
            return 'resistance'
        return 'none'

    gene_summary['drug_class'] = gene_summary.apply(classify, axis=1)
    # A directional MAGeCK call should agree with the sign of the required gene-median LFC.
    called = gene_summary['drug_class'].ne('none')
    assert (np.sign(gene_summary.loc[called, 'lfc_drug']) ==
            gene_summary.loc[called, 'drug_class'].map({'sensitiser': -1, 'resistance': 1})).all()
    gene_summary = gene_summary[
        ['gene', 'lfc_fitness', 'lfc_drug', 'drug_class', 'n_sgRNAs',
         'fdr_sensitiser', 'fdr_resistance']
    ]

    references = pd.read_csv(in_dir / 'reference_genes.tsv', sep='\t', dtype=str)
    checked = references.merge(gene_summary[['gene', 'drug_class']], on='gene', how='left', validate='one_to_one')
    assert checked['drug_class'].notna().all()
    modifiers = checked['expected_class'].ne('none')
    correct_modifiers = int((modifiers & checked['drug_class'].eq(checked['expected_class'])).sum())
    false_none_calls = int((~modifiers & checked['drug_class'].ne('none')).sum())
    assert correct_modifiers >= 9 and false_none_calls <= 1
    print(f'{screen}: reference criterion passed ({correct_modifiers}/10 modifiers, {false_none_calls} false none calls)')

    gene_summary.to_csv(out_dir / 'gene_summary.tsv', sep='\t', index=False, float_format='%.8g')

    audit = pd.DataFrame(
        [(item, value if isinstance(value, str) else value[screen]) for item, value in AUDITS],
        columns=['item', 'verdict'],
    )
    assert len(audit) == 8 and set(audit['verdict']) <= {'ok', 'defective'}
    audit.to_csv(out_dir / 'audit.tsv', sep='\t', index=False)

    mailed = pd.read_csv(in_dir / 'handover' / 'hits_mailed.tsv', sep='\t', dtype={'gene': str})
    assert mailed['gene'].is_unique and set(mailed['gene']) <= targeted
    class_by_gene = gene_summary.set_index('gene')['drug_class']
    erratum = pd.DataFrame({
        'gene': mailed['gene'],
        'verdict': mailed['gene'].map(lambda g: 'confirmed' if class_by_gene[g] != 'none' else 'retracted'),
    })
    erratum.to_csv(out_dir / 'erratum.tsv', sep='\t', index=False)

    qc = {'samples': {sample: sample_qc[sample] for sample in sheet['sample_id']}}
    with open(out_dir / 'qc.json', 'w') as handle:
        json.dump(qc, handle, indent=2)
        handle.write('\n')

    print(f'{screen}: wrote deliverables to {out_dir}')

import json
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

ARMS={
 'A':{'T0':['LIB8','LIB9'],'vehicle':['LIB11','LIB12','LIB15'],'drug':['LIB10','LIB13','LIB14']},
 'B':{'T0':['LIB6','LIB7'],'vehicle':['LIB8','LIB9','LIB13'],'drug':['LIB10','LIB11','LIB12']},
 'C':{'T0':['LIB8','LIB9'],'vehicle':['LIB10','LIB12','LIB13'],'drug':['LIB11','LIB14','LIB15']},
}
for X in 'ABC':
    out=Path(f'/task/output/part_{X}')
    lib=pd.read_csv(f'/task/input/part_{X}/library.tsv',sep='\t',dtype=str)
    sheet=pd.read_csv(f'/task/input/part_{X}/samples.tsv',sep='\t',dtype=str)
    ref=pd.read_csv(f'/task/input/part_{X}/reference_genes.tsv',sep='\t',dtype=str)
    mailed=pd.read_csv(f'/task/input/part_{X}/handover/hits_mailed.tsv',sep='\t',dtype={'gene':str})
    c=pd.read_csv(out/'counts.tsv',sep='\t',dtype={'sgRNA':str,'gene':str}).set_index('sgRNA')
    g=pd.read_csv(out/'gene_summary.tsv',sep='\t',dtype={'gene':str})
    a=pd.read_csv(out/'audit.tsv',sep='\t')
    e=pd.read_csv(out/'erratum.tsv',sep='\t',dtype={'gene':str})
    qc=json.load(open(out/'qc.json'))
    C=c[sheet.sample_id].astype(float)
    assert (C.sum(axis=0).astype(int)==pd.Series({s:qc['samples'][s]['mapped_reads'] for s in sheet.sample_id})).all()
    ordered=ARMS[X]['T0']+ARMS[X]['vehicle']+ARMS[X]['drug']
    n=C[ordered]/C[ordered].sum(axis=0)
    def ratio(treatment,control):
        return np.log2(n[treatment].mean(axis=1).to_numpy()/n[control].mean(axis=1).to_numpy())
    fit=ratio(ARMS[X]['vehicle'],ARMS[X]['T0'])
    drug=ratio(ARMS[X]['drug'],ARMS[X]['vehicle'])
    nt=(lib.gene=='NON_TARGETING').to_numpy()
    fit-=np.median(fit[nt]); drug-=np.median(drug[nt])
    guide=pd.DataFrame({'sgRNA':lib.sgRNA,'gene':lib.gene,'fit':fit,'drug':drug})
    expected=guide.groupby('gene',sort=True).agg(lfc_fitness=('fit','median'),lfc_drug=('drug','median')).reset_index()
    got=g[['gene','lfc_fitness','lfc_drug']].sort_values('gene').reset_index(drop=True)
    pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(expected.round(10),got.round(10),check_exact=False,rtol=1e-9,atol=1e-10)
    assert np.allclose(g.fdr_sensitiser<=0.05,g.drug_class.eq('sensitiser'))
    assert np.allclose(g.fdr_resistance<=0.05,g.drug_class.eq('resistance'))
    z=ref.merge(g[['gene','drug_class']],on='gene',validate='one_to_one')
    mod=z.expected_class.ne('none')
    correct=int((mod&z.drug_class.eq(z.expected_class)).sum())
    false=int((~mod&z.drug_class.ne('none')).sum())
    assert correct>=9 and false<=1
    cls=g.set_index('gene').drug_class
    expected_err=mailed.gene.map(lambda x:'confirmed' if cls[x]!='none' else 'retracted')
    assert e.gene.tolist()==mailed.gene.tolist() and e.verdict.tolist()==expected_err.tolist()
    expected_items=['library_release','sample_columns','stagger_reads','read2_library','arm_labels','control_normalisation','drug_baseline','contrast_sign']
    assert a.item.tolist()==expected_items
    print(f'{X}: independent LFC/QC/reference/erratum checks passed ({correct}/10 modifiers, {false} false none calls)')
print('\nFinal content validation passed for all screens.')

import json

import pandas as pd

ARMS={
 'A':{'T0':['LIB8','LIB9'],'vehicle':['LIB11','LIB12','LIB15'],'drug':['LIB10','LIB13','LIB14']},
 'B':{'T0':['LIB6','LIB7'],'vehicle':['LIB8','LIB9','LIB13'],'drug':['LIB10','LIB11','LIB12']},
 'C':{'T0':['LIB8','LIB9'],'vehicle':['LIB10','LIB12','LIB13'],'drug':['LIB11','LIB14','LIB15']},
}
EXPECTED_AUDIT={
 'library_release':'defective',
 'sample_columns':{'A':'ok','B':'ok','C':'defective'},
 'stagger_reads':{'A':'ok','B':'ok','C':'defective'},
 'read2_library':{'A':'defective','B':'defective','C':'ok'},
 'arm_labels':'defective',
 'control_normalisation':{'A':'defective','B':'defective','C':'ok'},
 'drug_baseline':'ok',
 'contrast_sign':{'A':'ok','B':'ok','C':'defective'},
}
for X in 'ABC':
    out=Path(f'/task/output/part_{X}')
    required={'counts.tsv','gene_summary.tsv','audit.tsv','erratum.tsv','qc.json'}
    assert {p.name for p in out.iterdir() if p.is_file()} == required

    lib=pd.read_csv(f'/task/input/part_{X}/library.tsv',sep='\t',dtype=str)
    sheet=pd.read_csv(f'/task/input/part_{X}/samples.tsv',sep='\t',dtype=str)
    ref=pd.read_csv(f'/task/input/part_{X}/reference_genes.tsv',sep='\t',dtype=str)
    mailed=pd.read_csv(f'/task/input/part_{X}/handover/hits_mailed.tsv',sep='\t',dtype={'gene':str})
    c=pd.read_csv(out/'counts.tsv',sep='\t',dtype={'sgRNA':str,'gene':str}).set_index('sgRNA')
    g=pd.read_csv(out/'gene_summary.tsv',sep='\t',dtype={'gene':str})
    a=pd.read_csv(out/'audit.tsv',sep='\t')
    e=pd.read_csv(out/'erratum.tsv',sep='\t',dtype={'gene':str})
    qc=json.load(open(out/'qc.json'))

    assert c.shape==(1000,10) and c.columns.tolist()==['sgRNA','gene']+sheet.sample_id.tolist()
    assert c[['sgRNA','gene']].equals(lib[['sgRNA','gene']])
    assert all(c[col].dtype.kind in 'iu' for col in sheet.sample_id)
    assert (c[sheet.sample_id].sum(axis=0).astype(int)==pd.Series({s:qc['samples'][s]['mapped_reads'] for s in sheet.sample_id})).all()

    C=c[sheet.sample_id].astype(float)
    ordered=ARMS[X]['T0']+ARMS[X]['vehicle']+ARMS[X]['drug']
    n=C[ordered]/C[ordered].sum(axis=0)
    def ratio(treatment,control):
        return np.log2(n[treatment].mean(axis=1).to_numpy()/n[control].mean(axis=1).to_numpy())
    fit=ratio(ARMS[X]['vehicle'],ARMS[X]['T0'])
    drug=ratio(ARMS[X]['drug'],ARMS[X]['vehicle'])
    targeted=(lib.gene.ne('NON_TARGETING')).to_numpy()
    guide=pd.DataFrame({'sgRNA':lib.sgRNA,'gene':lib.gene,'fit':fit,'drug':drug}).loc[targeted]
    expected=guide.groupby('gene',sort=True).agg(lfc_fitness=('fit','median'),lfc_drug=('drug','median')).reset_index()
    got=g[['gene','lfc_fitness','lfc_drug']].sort_values('gene').reset_index(drop=True)
    assert expected.gene.tolist()==got.gene.tolist() and len(expected)==230
    np.testing.assert_allclose(expected.lfc_fitness,got.lfc_fitness,rtol=1e-7,atol=1e-7)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(expected.lfc_drug,got.lfc_drug,rtol=1e-7,atol=1e-7)

    assert len(g)==230 and g.gene.nunique()==230 and 'NON_TARGETING' not in set(g.gene)
    assert np.isfinite(g[['lfc_fitness','lfc_drug','fdr_sensitiser','fdr_resistance']].to_numpy()).all()
    assert (np.where(g.fdr_sensitiser<=0.05,g.drug_class.eq('sensitiser'),True)).all()
    assert (np.where(g.fdr_resistance<=0.05,g.drug_class.eq('resistance'),True)).all()
    assert set(g.drug_class)<={'sensitiser','resistance','none'}

    z=ref.merge(g[['gene','drug_class']],on='gene',validate='one_to_one')
    modifier=z.expected_class.ne('none')
    correct=int((modifier & z.drug_class.eq(z.expected_class)).sum())
    false=int((~modifier & z.drug_class.ne('none')).sum())
    assert correct>=9 and false<=1

    expected_audit={item:(value if isinstance(value,str) else value[X]) for item,value in EXPECTED_AUDIT.items()}
    assert a.item.tolist()==list(EXPECTED_AUDIT) and dict(zip(a.item,a.verdict))==expected_audit
    cls=g.set_index('gene').drug_class
    expected_errata=mailed.gene.map(lambda gene:'confirmed' if cls[gene]!='none' else 'retracted')
    assert e.gene.tolist()==mailed.gene.tolist() and e.verdict.tolist()==expected_errata.tolist()

    actual_arms={sample:arm for arm,samples in ARMS[X].items() for sample in samples}
    assert all(qc['samples'][s]['arm']==actual_arms[s] for s in sheet.sample_id)
    assert all(v['total_reads']>=v['mapped_reads']>0 for v in qc['samples'].values())

    # Confirm every corrected day-14 assignment from guide-profile similarity.
    t0=ARMS[X]['T0']; day14=ARMS[X]['vehicle']+ARMS[X]['drug']
    L=np.log2((n[day14]+1e-6).div(n[t0].mean(axis=1)+1e-6,axis=0))
    corr=L.corr()
    for sample in day14:
        same=[s for s in day14 if s!=sample and actual_arms[s]==actual_arms[sample]]
        other=[s for s in day14 if actual_arms[s]!=actual_arms[sample]]
        assert corr.loc[sample,same].mean()>corr.loc[sample,other].mean()
    print(f'{X}: independent validation passed; references {correct}/10 modifiers, {false} false none calls')
print('\nFINAL VALIDATION PASSED FOR ALL THREE SCREENS')
